candidates.description: This vector represents physical and numerical measurements, dimensions, and concentrations of substances or quantities.
This vector represents thermodynamic and energy-related concepts, including temperature, heat, and power.
This feature vector activates on verbs and actions related to modification, growth, reduction, or quantitative change.
These tokens function as conjunctive adverbs and transitional transition markers that indicate logical relationships, sequence, or modification between clauses.
Quantifiers and distributive determiners denoting amount, selection, or totality.
This vector represents Greek alphabet letters and mathematical or scientific symbols.
This feature activates for words related to manufacturing, creation, and the production of goods or concepts.
This vector represents discrete physical or abstract constituents that make up a whole.
This vector represents words related to capability, susceptibility, or chemical properties, frequently ending in or relating to the suffix "-able" or "-ible".
This vector represents chemical elements, compounds, and related chemical terminology.
